literal_gloss: Read-by-me of-Gregory of-Nyssa likewise on-behalf of-Basil against Eunomius. In expression, if any other, of-orator, brilliant and of-pleasure worthy preserving, yet not in-order even himself the of-Eunomius writing refutes. Wherefore also briefer is than-Theodore, of-Sophronius fuller; he-abounds in reflections and examples. One-may fearlessly say, as-much surpasses in beauty and brilliance and sweetest Theodore, so-much he him in number of arguments and the fruitful toward the immediate strains.
source_text: Codex 6 Greek from photius_bibliotheca_greek_lock.txt (Bekker 1824, pp. 3; closeout-4b transcription)
